name: upwork-skills
description: Screening and safe submission for Upwork freelancers, built on the official Upwork connector.

plugins.name: upwork-skills
plugins.description: Screens Upwork posts against your own rules before you spend Connects, submits a proposal only after you approve the exact preview, logs every bid with the signals it was judged on and tracks it to its outcome, and keeps a scheduled scan on the same rules.
